correctness.rationale: From xdot=x(1-x)-sqrt(x)y, ydot=(c sqrt(x)-s)y, the coexistence point (u²,u(1-u²)) differentiates to A=[[-z,-b],[d,0]], valid for c>0 and 0<u<1. Independent-coordinate multiplicative Itô noises yield K=[[-δ,-2b,0],[d,-z,-b],[0,2d,Q]], δ=2z-P. Direct symbolic reconstruction confirms char_K(λ)=λ³+(z+δ-Q)λ²+(4bd+zδ-(z+δ)Q)λ+[2bdδ-Q(2bd+zδ)]. Mean-square exponential decay forces A Hurwitz and z>0. Existence of positive stochastic Lyapunov H normalized by h11>0 gives δ-2dη>0, 2bη-Qζ>0, dζ=b+zη, hence 0<η<δ/(2d), η>Qb/(2bd-Qz), forcing δ>0 and Q(2bd+zδ)<2bdδ. Conversely these strict inequalities give nonempty η interval; H=[[1,η],[η,(b+zη)/d]] has det=b/d+η(z/d-η)>0 because 0<η<δ/(2d)<=z/d, and stochastic generator is strictly negative diagonal. This proves all parameter quantifiers and excludes δ=0 and Q-frontier equality; P*=2z, Q*=2bdz/(bd+z²)<P*. An independently written SymPy/NumPy verifier checks all symbolic identities, 8,800 randomized positive-region/boundary/outside configurations and 100 deterministically unstable cases. Numerical tests corroborate, never substitute for proof.

value.rationale: The exact simultaneous prey/predator noise stability set is a natural biologically motivated invariant of the specific coexistence equilibrium, not an arbitrary parameter slice. A closed rational boundary and sharp single-species thresholds can directly inform quantitative comparisons and eliminate numerical eigenvalue sweeps, while the strict ordering holds throughout a continuum of parameter choices. Mathematical usefulness is judged separately from originality: the formula is a useful explicit form even though an earlier exact spectral characterization already determines the same set. This does not claim new stochastic stability theory or nonlinear ecological conclusions.

final_claim: For c>0, 0<s<c, u=s/c, z=(3u²-1)/2, b=u, d=c(1-u²)/2, independent Itô noises of squared intensities P,Q>=0, the equilibrium-centered linearized SDE is exponentially mean-square stable iff 1/√3<u<1, P<2z, and Q<2bd(2z-P)/(2bd+z(2z-P)); strict at both boundaries; P*=2z and Q*=2bdz/(bd+z²)<P*.
